game_title: Max Finder Derby – Root Tunnels Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels, tunnels among huge roots: the fairy gardener must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels: tunnels among huge roots
core_gameplay_loop: In Root Tunnels, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round, wasp swarms strike the elder's door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the elder's door from wasp swarms in Root Tunnels: keep the best meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: best drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against wasp swarms in Root Tunnels.
